name: Olive oil
description: Olive oil (CAS 8001-25-0 ) is a cold-pressed or refined vegetable oil derived from the fruit of Olea europaea, traded globally across food, cosmetic, and pharmaceutical supply chains. It functions as an emollient, carrier, and lubricant across a broad range of formulated products. In food manufacturing, it serves as a cooking medium, salad dressing base, and functional ingredient in marinades, sauces, and preserved goods where flavor profile and fat composition drive sourcing decisions. Cosmetic formulators incorporate it into skin creams, hair conditioners, lip balms, and massage oils, where its skin-conditioning performance justifies its use over lower-cost alternatives. Pharmaceutical and nutraceutical manufacturers use it as an excipient and carrier oil in softgel capsules, topical preparations, and oral liquid formulations for various applications. Industrial-grade sulfur olive oil has a distinct role as a textile lubricant and leather softening agent. Olive oil is supplied as a liquid in bulk containers, intermediate bulk containers (IBCs), and drums. Commercially available grades include extra virgin, virgin, refined, and pomace, each meeting different quality benchmarks. Food-grade material is supplied to FCC and Ph. Eur. specifications. Pharmaceutical-grade material is available to USP and BP standards. These certifications ensure the product meets the rigorous safety and purity requirements for global distribution and manufacturing. Contact us for supply of Olive oil Request Quote
